_comment: Hand-maintained judgement columns for the NX2-005 license ledger. Evidence columns (repo, commit, sha256, archive state) come from docs/research/license-evidence/evidence.json via build_ledger.py. Notice shorthands are expanded in docs/research/license-ledger.md section 3. license_carveouts: a restricted licence (GPL family, SSPL, RSAL, BUSL, LicenseRef-) detected upstream but deliberately left out of spdx_expression; bound to the file sha256 and the recommendation it was reviewed for (check_ledger.py rule 4b).

rows.binary_distribution_terms: Official CE binaries/images/AMIs since v16 ship under the Teleport Community Edition License (build.assets/LICENSE-community): only orgs with <100 employees AND <US$10M annual revenue; no resale or embedding in products/services. Self-compiled source is AGPL-3.0-or-later; api/ Go module is Apache-2.0.
rows.notice_obligations: AGPL: offer Corresponding Source to network users of any modified build. Apache-2.0 for api/ client module if vendored.
rows.network_copyleft_trigger: YES - AGPL-3.0 s.13 if Nexus modifies Teleport and users interact with it over a network. Linking Teleport server code into Nexus would make Nexus AGPL.
rows.redistribution_limits: Never bundle, re-host, mirror or embed Teleport binaries/images in Nexus artifacts. Operators install Teleport themselves from goteleport.com under the terms that apply to them. The api/ module (Apache-2.0) may be used as a client library.
rows.alternatives: Keycloak + step-ca (both Apache-2.0); OpenSSH certificate auth
rows.notes: Matches plan section 5.1. CE eligibility depends on the operating organisation's size (decision D3); Nexus must not ship features that assume Enterprise-only Teleport capabilities. Primary source for CE terms: goteleport.com/blog/teleport-community-license/ (retrieved 2026-11-10).

rows.notes: COPYING is a DEP-5 file. Files: * = 'LGPL-2.1 or LGPL-3', so -only is the conservative reading. COPYING lines 220-228 grant AGPL-3.0 only to two developer scripts, src/script/backport-create-issue and src/script/backport-resolve-issue (release tooling, not shipped in RGW/RADOS runtime packages), so network_copyleft_trigger = NO for the S3 service. Recorded as a license_carveouts entry.

license_carveouts.reason: DEP-5 stanzas at COPYING lines 220-228 scope AGPL-3.0 to src/script/backport-create-issue and src/script/backport-resolve-issue only: developer release tooling, not part of the RGW runtime that Nexus would talk to over S3. Nexus never vendors Ceph source.

Dual licensing lets the recipient choose; Nexus elects Apache-2.0 so it stays compatible with an Apache-2.0/MIT outbound licence (ledger F9) and records the election in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.
